missions.title: Missions
missions.intro: The study connects four objectives across the ATCO workforce, training and licensing system.
items: Understanding shortages
Explain the drivers of workforce imbalance and explore how supply and demand may evolve.
Taking stock of existing practices
Understand how recruitment, training, licensing and operational deployment work across different settings.
Looking for best practices and solutions
Examine reported practices and potential measures, their prerequisites and their relevance to different actors.
Future-proofing the framework
Explore how changing operations and automation could affect tasks, competence, training and licensing.

expeditions.title: Our expeditions
expeditions.intro: Follow the investigations that connect the study’s questions to its evidence and outputs.
items: Exploring the data
Data sources, indicator definitions, historical trends and analytical limitations.
Listening to operational experience
Interviews and the survey: what was asked, who contributed and how the evidence was interpreted.
Modelling workforce supply and demand
Model development, assumptions, scenarios and sensitivity analysis.
Investigating challenges and solutions
From reported constraints and their causes to candidate measures and prioritisation.
Exploring future competence and licensing
ATCO task analysis, automation, L.O.A.T., P/A/S/I/N and the proposed CBL framework.

artefacts.title: Artefacts
artefacts.intro: The tools and conceptual frameworks developed to help the community understand and work with the study.
items: The ATCO pipeline
A framework linking planning, hiring, training, qualification, deployment and operational feedback.
The supply–demand model
A tool for exploring workforce requirements, supply and conditional projections.
The challenges and solutions catalogue
An organised collection of constraints and responses, with ANSP, governance and technical perspectives.
The proposed competence and licensing framework
Task, automation and competence concepts supporting the exploration of future licensing options.
The Knowledge Atlas
Connected explanations, tools, evidence and publications, brought together in one place.
artefacts.note: The common expected baseline remains a possible addition to the catalogue. Publication and usage details for each tool will be established in the full Atlas.

discoveries.title: Discoveries and directions
discoveries.intro: Explore findings, their implications and recommendations through the responsibilities of different audiences.
items: For the European Commission and EASA
European policy, regulatory development and enabling conditions, with their respective responsibilities made explicit.
For ANSP executives
Workforce planning, training capacity, deployment and implementation choices.
For NSAs and NCAs
Oversight, approval, consistency and the practical implications of proposed changes.
For ATCOs and training and licensing professionals
Training practice, assessment, competence, career development and changing operational roles.
discoveries.note: A central study finding: unit training constrains the conversion of recruitment into qualified controllers. Responses need to connect instructor resources, progression and operational demand.

library.title: Atlas Library
library.intro: The publications and supporting material behind the Atlas, with clear versions and access conditions.
items: Reports
The final report and earlier study reports, identified by their publication status and version.
Data and analytical outputs
Data tables, model results, charts and supporting methodological material.
Consultation material
The survey, summaries of results and appropriately anonymised interview synthesis.
Reference material
Supporting publications and material used in the study.
Presentations
Slides presented at public meetings and study events.
library.note: Interview summaries are not intended for publication. The Atlas can refer to consultation evidence and publish an appropriate anonymised synthesis.

encyclopaedia.title: Encyclopaedia
encyclopaedia.intro: Shared entries explain the concepts and context used throughout the Atlas.
items: Concepts and indicators
Definitions, units, scope and distinctions between related terms.
Regulation and policy
Relevant instruments and provisions, their status and their relationship to proposals.
Stakeholders
Roles, responsibilities and implementation dependencies.
Evidence and methods
Data provenance, model assumptions and the limits of particular findings.
Cases, initiatives and technologies
Operational examples, source-dated developments and technical functions.
encyclopaedia.note: Every pathway can link to the same reference entry. Detailed regulatory content will require verification before publication.

pipeline.title: The ATCO Pipeline
pipeline.intro: Follow the complete workforce management cycle and see how its stages depend on one another.
items: Plan and attract
Workforce planning, working conditions, recruitment and selection.
Train and qualify
Initial training, unit training, assessment, licensing and sector qualifications.
Deploy and sustain
Rostering, operational work, competence maintenance, retention and career transitions.
Learn and replan
Use operational experience and performance analysis to improve the next cycle.
pipeline.note: The pipeline is both an artefact to explore and a pathway connecting explanations across the Atlas.

shortage.title: Understanding the ATCO Shortage
shortage.intro: Move from defining a shortage to reading the evidence and understanding conditional projections.
items: Define the question
Distinguish workforce numbers, deployability and the capacity that can be delivered.
Read the evidence
Examine workforce, traffic, operational hours, productivity and delay indicators.
Understand the model
Explore how demand, training inflows, retirements and attrition affect the gap.
Explore uncertainty
Compare scenarios and sensitivities while keeping assumptions and model versions visible.
shortage.note: The final draft’s outlook to 2036 and the intermediate report’s outlook to 2040 are separate model versions.

solutions.title: Challenges & Solutions
solutions.intro: Connect a reported problem to possible responses, their dependencies and the actors who could implement them.
items: Understand the constraint
Examine where a problem arises and the evidence supporting its explanation.
Inspect possible responses
Explore measures affecting planning, hiring, training, licensing and operations.
Assess applicability
Consider prerequisites, feasibility, time to effect and the limits of transferability.
Build a coordinated response
Connect complementary measures and identify responsibilities and monitoring needs.
solutions.note: Reported practices and future proposals retain their source status. A practice’s inclusion in the catalogue does not itself demonstrate its effectiveness.

future.title: The Future ATCO
future.intro: Follow the reasoning from changing operations to the tasks, competence and recognition they may require.
items: Operations and technology
Explore service concepts, technical systems, decision support and automation.
Tasks and human roles
Examine what controllers perform, approve, supervise or intervene in, and what may no longer be licence-critical.
Competence and learning
Connect core, technical-system and operational-environment competence to training and assessment.
Licensing and transition
Explore proposed recognition options, transferability, delta training and the evidence needed for change.
future.note: The competence and licensing concepts are proposals for exploration, with validation and implementation questions still to resolve.
